subject: Hospitality
title: Fred Harvey: Civilizing the West
description: A quick, practical guide to Fred Harvey: Civilizing the West.

hook.text: Fred Harvey brought fine dining to the American frontier. His Harvey House restaurants lined railroad stops across the West.

buildup.text: Before Harvey, railroad food was terrible—stale sandwiches sold at filthy stations.

discovery.text: He hired 'Harvey Girls'—young women trained in strict service standards—who became cultural icons of the American West.

twist.text: Harvey Girls were among the first respectable working women in the frontier West. They helped settle entire communities.

climax.text: Fred Harvey proved that quality hospitality works anywhere—even in the middle of a desert along a railroad track.

punchline.text: Fine dining in the wild West. Harvey proved standards travel anywhere.

quiz.question: Who were the 'Harvey Girls'?
options: Young women trained in strict service standards at Harvey restaurants
